questions.question: Which state in India achieved a literacy rate of 99.30%, becoming fully literate as declared on International Literacy Day 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Himachal Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Himachal Pradesh was declared fully literate by its Chief Minister on International Literacy Day, achieving a 99.30% literacy rate, surpassing the national average of 95%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Himachal Pradesh became the fourth state, after Tripura, Mizoram, and Goa, to achieve full functional literacy.**
 
• Ladakh is the first fully literate Union Territory of India.
 
• India's national literacy rate rose from 74% in 2011 to 80.9% in 2023–24.
 
• The ULLAS Nav Bharat Saaksharta Karyakram enrolled over 3 crore learners with a 90% success rate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• ULLAS Nav Bharat Saaksharta Karyakram__

 __
 
• A national literacy initiative aimed at promoting education and increasing literacy across India with over 3 crore learners enrolled.
 
 
 
• International Literacy Day (ILD)__
 __
 
• Observed annually on September 8, ILD highlights the importance of literacy, with a focus on different themes, such as "Promoting Literacy in the Digital Era" in 2025.
 
 
 
• India's Literacy Growth__
 
 
• The literacy rate in India has risen significantly, from 74% in 2011 to 80.9% in 2023–24, showing continued progress in national education efforts.

questions.question: Where was the 25th Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) Summit held in 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Tianjin, China**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The 25th SCO Summit was held in Tianjin, China, from August 31 to September 1, 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The 25th SCO Summit took place in Tianjin, China, with discussions focusing on security, global governance, economic cooperation, and sustainable development.
 
• PM Modi highlighted India’s vision for SCO under three pillars: security, connectivity, and opportunity.
 
• The summit resulted in the adoption of the Tianjin Declaration, reaffirming commitments to peace, cooperation, and a shared future.
 
• India reiterated its support for SCO reforms and the need for a multilateral system that represents the Global South's interests.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Tianjin Declaration__

 __
 
• The Tianjin Declaration emphasized collective efforts in AI, energy, sustainable development, and shaping a shared future for humanity.
 
 
 
• SCO Vision__
 __
 
• PM Modi presented India’s approach to the SCO, focusing on combating terrorism, promoting infrastructure, and fostering innovation and cultural dialogue.
 
 
 
• Chabahar Port and INSTC__
 __
 
• India reaffirmed its support for the Chabahar Port and the International North-South Transport Corridor to enhance connectivity and trade in the region.
 
 
 
• Civilizational Dialogue Forum__
 
 
• A proposal by PM Modi to establish a forum under SCO to promote cultural exchanges and understanding among member nations.

questions.question: According to the Air Quality Life Index (AQLI), which country is ranked as the second most polluted in the world?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**India.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India is ranked as the second most polluted country in the world according to the Air Quality Life Index (AQLI).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **India has the second-highest level of air pollution globally, reducing life expectancy by an average of 3.5 years due to severe air quality issues.**
 
• The AQLI is developed by Professor Michael Greenstone and the Energy Policy Institute at the University of Chicago (EPIC), offering hyper-local data on the impact of air pollution on life expectancy.
 
• **South Asia, including India, Bangladesh, Nepal, and Pakistan, remains the most polluted region in the world.**
 
• The report emphasizes the urgent need for evidence-based policies to reduce air pollution and improve public health.
 
• India’s air pollution level significantly impacts life expectancy, with some regions like Northern India losing up to 8.2 years of life due to severe air quality degradation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Air Quality Life Index (AQLI):__ A measure developed to show how air pollution affects life expectancy by translating pollution levels into years of life lost.
 
• __Bangladesh:__ Currently ranked as the most polluted country globally, with air pollution levels 12 times higher than the WHO limits.
 
• __China:__ Has made significant progress in reducing pollution by 40.8% since 2014 through aggressive policies like cleaner heating and traffic restrictions.

questions.question: Which initiative has the Indian government launched to develop autonomous AI capabilities, including the creation of large language models?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**IndiaAI Mission**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Indian government has launched the IndiaAI Mission to develop autonomous AI capabilities, including large language models and sector-specific AI applications.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The IndiaAI Mission aims to develop autonomous AI capabilities through sector-specific AI applications, sovereign large language models (LLMs), and skilling programs.**
 
• **The government has allocated ₹988.6 crore for the development of an LLM with 1 trillion parameters by an IIT Bombay consortium.**
 
• **The initiative is part of the government's broader strategy to enhance AI infrastructure and foster innovation in AI technologies.**
 
• **The IndiaAI Mission is approved with an expenditure of ₹10,300 crore, highlighting the government’s commitment to advancing AI research and development.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **IndiaAI Mission**__

 __
 
• A key initiative by the Indian government to foster AI capabilities through research, development, and skilling programs.
 
• Focuses on creating sovereign AI technologies, including LLMs with massive parameter capacities.
 
 
 
• **Large Language Models (LLMs)**__
 __
 
• LLMs with large numbers of parameters, like the one being developed by IIT Bombay’s consortium, are designed to perform a variety of AI tasks including natural language understanding and generation.
 
 
 
• **AI Impact Summit 2026**__
 
 
• The announcement was part of the pre-event for the AI Impact Summit 2026, which will showcase AI's transformative potential for various sectors.

questions.question: Which Indian state will benefit from the $126-million loan agreement signed with the Asian Development Bank for promoting sustainable tourism?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarakhand.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India and the Asian Development Bank have signed a $126-million loan agreement to promote sustainable tourism in Uttarakhand.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The project focuses on Tehri Garhwal District, one of the most climate-vulnerable and economically disadvantaged areas in Uttarakhand.
 
• The project aims to benefit over 87,000 residents and 2.7 million annual visitors through improved tourism planning, upgraded infrastructure, enhanced sanitation and waste management, and disaster preparedness.
 
• **The agreement was signed by Juhi Mukherjee, Joint Secretary, Department of Economic Affairs, on behalf of India.**
 
• **Kai Wei Yeo, Officer-in-Charge, India Resident Mission, signed on behalf of the Asian Development Bank.**
 
• **The project will strengthen sustainable tourism infrastructure and services in Uttarakhand.**
 
• **Focus areas include tourism planning, infrastructure improvement, sanitation, waste management, and disaster preparedness.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Tehri Garhwal District__

 __
 
• Located in Uttarakhand, India.
 
• Highly vulnerable to climate change impacts.
 
• Targeted for development under sustainable tourism projects.
 
 
 
• Asian Development Bank (ADB)__
 __
 
• Multilateral development bank headquartered in Manila, Philippines.
 
• Supports projects in Asia-Pacific regions to promote sustainable development and economic growth.
 
 
 
• Sustainable Tourism__
 
 
• Tourism development that balances environmental, social, and economic considerations.
 
• Focuses on long-term benefits for local communities while minimizing ecological impact.

questions.question: Where was the 14th edition of Exercise MAITREE, a bilateral military exercise between India and Thailand, held?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Joint Training Node (JTN), Umroi, Meghalaya.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The 14th edition of Exercise MAITREE is being held at the Joint Training Node (JTN) in Umroi, Meghalaya, from 1st to 14th September 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Exercise MAITREE has been a key bilateral initiative since 2006, aiming to enhance mutual understanding and joint tactical capabilities between India and Thailand.**
 
• This bilateral military exercise, involving India and Thailand, focuses on enhancing operational interoperability and strategic cooperation between the two nations.
 
• The exercise this year focuses on company-level counter-terrorist operations in semi-urban terrain under the framework of the United Nations Charter.
 
• The Indian Army is represented by a battalion from the Madras Regiment, while Thailand’s Royal Army has deployed personnel from its 1st Infantry Battalion.
 
• The exercise takes place as part of a rotational format, with the previous edition held in Thailand, continuing the annual collaboration between the two countries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Exercise MAITREE:__ A long-standing bilateral military exercise initiated in 2006 to strengthen defense cooperation between India and Thailand.
 
• __UN Chapter VII:__ Refers to actions to maintain or restore international peace and security, under which this year's focus is on counter-terrorism operations.
 
• __Rotational Format:__ The exercise alternates between India and Thailand annually, showcasing the countries' continued military engagement and commitment to regional security.

questions.question: Which two wetlands have recently been designated as Ramsar sites in September 2025?

options.text: Keoladeo National Park and Sonepat Wetland

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Gokul Jalashaya and Udaipur Jheel.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Two wetlands in Bihar, Gokul Jalashaya in Buxar and Udaipur Jheel in West Champaran, have been designated as Ramsar sites of international importance.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gokul Jalashaya spans 448 hectares in Buxar district, while Udaipur Jheel covers 319 hectares in West Champaran district.**
 
• **With these additions, India now has a total of 94 Ramsar sites, covering 13,60,719 hectares nationwide.**
 
• **Ramsar sites are wetlands recognized under the Ramsar Convention for their international ecological importance.**
 
• **The Ramsar Convention is headquartered in Gland, Switzerland, and aims to conserve and sustainably use wetlands globally.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Gokul Jalashaya__

 __
 
• Located in Buxar district, Bihar; significant for supporting biodiversity and wetland ecosystems.
 
 
 
• Udaipur Jheel__
 __
 
• Located in West Champaran district, Bihar; important for migratory birds and local hydrology.
 
 
 
• Ramsar Convention__
 __
 
• International treaty established in 1971 to conserve wetlands and promote sustainable use.
 
 
 
• India’s Wetlands Network__
 
 
• India now has 96 Ramsar sites, reflecting ongoing commitment to wetland conservation and biodiversity protection.

questions.question: Which fighter aircraft was officially decommissioned by the Indian Air Force on 26 September 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**MiG-21.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India formally decommissioned the iconic MiG-21 fighter aircraft on 26 September 2025 at Air Force Station Chandigarh, marking the end of a 62-year era in the IAF.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The MiG-21 was first inducted into the IAF in 1963 at Chandigarh Air Force Station and over 870 aircraft were procured over decades.**
 
• **It participated in major operations including the 1965 & 1971 wars with Pakistan, the 1999 Kargil Conflict, and the 2019 Balakot Airstrikes.**
 
• **The final operational flight took place on 24 September 2025, and the last squadron operating the aircraft was No. 23 Squadron “Panthers.”**
 
• **Decommissioning paves the way for IAF modernisation, including expansion of Tejas squadrons, additional Rafale jets, and future platforms like AMCA and MRFA projects.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Historical Significance__

 __
 
• The MiG-21 was India’s first supersonic fighter aircraft, introduced by the Soviet Union, and played a pivotal role in shaping the country’s air defence capabilities during the Cold War.
 
 
 
• Legacy Operations__
 __
 
• Known for speed, maneuverability, and agility, the MiG-21 served as the backbone of IAF for decades despite the induction of modern aircraft like Su-30MKI, Rafale, and Tejas LCA.
 
 
 
• Modernisation Impact__
 __
 
• The retirement enables the IAF to focus on indigenized and technologically advanced fighter platforms, moving away from Cold War-era imports.
 
 
 
• Ceremony Attendees__
 
 
• Defence Minister Rajnath Singh, Chief of Defence Staff Gen Anil Chauhan, Air Chief Marshal A.P. Singh, Army Chief Gen Upendra Dwivedi, and Navy Chief Admiral Dinesh K. Tripathi attended the decommissioning ceremony.

questions.question: Which AI-powered robot developed by ISRO will be deployed in the uncrewed test flight for India's Gaganyaan mission in December 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Vyommitra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Vyommitra, an AI-powered half-humanoid robot, will be deployed in an uncrewed test flight of India's Gaganyaan space mission in December 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vyommitra is an AI-powered robot developed by ISRO, designed to simulate human functions during flight.**
 
• **It will play a key role in testing life support systems and assessing onboard conditions in preparation for India’s first manned space mission.**
 
• **Vyommitra is part of the Gaganyaan Mission, India’s first human spaceflight program.**
 
• **The robot will be aboard the uncrewed test flight scheduled for December 2025, aimed at simulating human presence in space.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Gaganyaan Mission**__

 __
 
• India's first human spaceflight program.
 
• Objective: Send astronauts to a 400 km low Earth orbit (LEO) for 3 days.
 
• Uncrewed test flight scheduled for December 2025.
 
• Aimed at testing life support systems, safety protocols, and re-entry mechanisms.
 
 
 
• **Vyommitra**__
 
 
• AI-powered, half-humanoid robot.
 
• Developed by ISRO to simulate astronaut functions in space.
 
• Monitors environmental parameters like pressure, temperature, and CO₂ inside the spacecraft.
